F1: mainHostDestinationCalendar` is undefined when `evt.destinationCalendar` is null, and `EventManager.ts:119` dereferences `.integration` without optional chaining for Meet locations.
F2: the fallback at `CalendarService.ts:254-256` and `:315-317` only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy and then matches `externalId` against it, so it always yields undefined.
F3: selectedCalendar` only matches by `credentialId`, so credential-less destinations insert into `primary`, and the callback-less `events.patch` at line 168 gets an undefined `calendarId`.
F4: the Office365, Lark and CalDAV `createEvent` methods all use `destinationCalendar[0]` whichever credential calls them, and CalDAV returns success after filtering to zero calendars.
F5: create.handler.ts:151` sets the slug only when billing is enabled (alongside `requestedSlug`), so with billing disabled the org has a null slug and `getPublicEvent.ts` treats it as unpublished; the "previous code" half of the claim could not be diffed here.
F6: the catch at `handleNewBooking.ts:757-761` rewraps Prisma errors as an `HttpError` with the raw message, which bypasses `redactError`, and replaces every other error with a generic 500 without logging the cause.
F7: destinationCalendar` is `null` when neither the event type nor the organizer has one, so the optional-chained `push` at line 1078 discards the collected team destinations.
F8: webhookData` spreads `evt` at `handleNewBooking.ts:2297`, so the payload's `destinationCalendar` is now an array (plus `schedulingType`), changing the outgoing webhook shape.
